steps.path: A conversation after a native summary, or when choosing a smaller model
steps.headline: This is what done means for the new summary behavior.

rows.statement: Older messages summarized natively are dimmed, while recent messages kept alongside the summary remain at normal contrast.
A model that fits switches directly; an overfull chat asks to summarize on the current model, switching only if that summary fits.
At phone width, the summarize-or-dismiss choice fits, and X or Esc leaves my chat and current model unchanged.
